transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, our pension-fund client wants to renew its securities-lending mandate for six months. The mandate currently covers $40 million of securities available for lending. Before I make a decision on the renewal and its operating terms, I'd like to run through our standard cross-functional pre-approval review. Could each of you — risk, legal, operations, and client coverage — share any relevant findings so I can factor them into my decision?
